summary: CCC-built steel fire tower on Keeney Knob, Summers County, WV, dated 1937; 2024 local report says the cabin is no longer reachable.

facts.design: Steel fire tower, 88 feet per the Register, with a lookout cabin on top

staffing.status: keeper named 1936-37; no later staffing record found

visit.trail_note: A May 2024 local report says the cabin floor is gone and the cabin is not accessible; no current access rules found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: An August 1936 item calls the tower under construction, but later 1937 items describe erection starting in 1937 and completion that October; the Register's 1937 date is used and the 1936 item is treated as premature

sources.title: A Peek into Summers County's Past: The Fire Tower

notes_for_editor: Heights disagree: 75, 79, 85 and 88 feet across 1936-37 items and the Register; the story reports the spread and does not pick one. County disagrees: the Register and FFLOS list say Summers, a January 1937 item says Greenbrier. Elevation: Register 3,923 ft (1,196 m); 1937 items say 3,945 ft. The keeper is named 1936 in one item and appointed 1937 in another. Current condition rests on a May 2024 Hinton News article and the FFLOS list; no 2025-26 source found. No current access or staffing source found. Wikipedia Keeney's Knob read as a lead only (elevation 3,921 ft, transmitter site) and not cited.
